items.title: What to watch: Broadcom, Snowflake earnings and ADP jobs data
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the stories that will be making headlines tomorrow, including earnings from Broadcom (AVGO) and Snowflake (SNOW), plus a fresh look at the labor market with ADP's private payrolls report ahead of Friday's highly anticipated jobs report.

items.title: Cramer Says Nvidia at 23 Times Earnings Needs a Half Trillion Dollar Buyback
items.summary: Jim Cramer wants Nvidia to announce the largest share repurchase in corporate history, and his valuation argument is harder to dismiss than his collateral logic deserves to be.

items.title: Broadcom Still Has Much to Prove
items.summary: Broadcom might be the biggest winner from the AI-chip craze after Nvidia, but circumstances have changed, and the disadvantages of its strategy are coming into sharper focus. Amid those shifts, its allure for investors is also changing.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: GitLab, Dell, Broadcom
items.summary: ↗️ GitLab (GTLB). Shares of the maker of software-development tools soared 13% in morning trading after its second-quarter result topped expectations both on revenue and earnings. ↗️ Dell Technologies (DELL): Shares rose more than 2% after it reported a big earnings and revenue beat thanks to demand for its servers.

items.title: AI Infrastructure Spending Is Set to Hit $1.4 Trillion by 2030. These Are the 3 Chip Stocks Positioned to Capture It.
items.summary: JPMorgan sees AI infrastructure spending surging toward a figure that would reshape entire markets, and the companies capable of manufacturing and designing the chips at that buildout's core fit on one hand. Three names sit at the chokepoint, and their latest earnings make the opportunity uncomfortably clear.
